expectations.text: Distinguishes Art. 30(2) baseline provisions for ALL ICT service arrangements (service descriptions, data locations, security, access/audit rights, termination) from Art. 30(3) enhanced provisions for critical/important functions
expectations.evidence: 'Baseline clauses required for ALL ICT third-party contracts (Article 30(2))' vs 'Enhanced clauses required ADDITIONALLY for contracts supporting critical or important functions (Article 30(3))'.

expectations.text: Lists key enhanced provisions: full audit and access rights (including for regulators), exit strategies and transition assistance, participation/cooperation in TLPT where relevant, notice periods and reporting obligations
expectations.evidence: Enhanced set includes 'unrestricted rights of access, inspection, and audit... and by the competent authority', 'Exit strategies: mandatory transition periods', 'participation in threat-led penetration testing (TLPT)', 'Notice periods and reporting obligations'.

expectations.text: Links to exit strategy duties (Art. 28(8)) and concentration/substitutability assessment (Art. 29)
expectations.evidence: Exit-strategy transition clauses covered, but no link to Art. 28(8) exit-strategy duties and no concentration/substitutability (Art. 29) assessment anywhere.

expectations.text: Mentions CTPP context where relevant: designated providers are under ESA oversight, but contracts remain the entity's compliance instrument
expectations.evidence: 'provisions for the Lead Overseer's recommendations regarding CTPPs (financial entities must be able to terminate if a Lead Overseer identifies serious concerns about a designated CTPP...)'.

expectations.text: Output is actionable: clause checklist or gap table rather than prose-only
expectations.evidence: Numbered 16-clause checklist split by tier plus practical negotiation notes - actionable, not prose-only.
